_comment: Content labels for the Media page (docs/design/files-showcase.md, 'Labels'). A labelled item stays hidden until the viewer clicks it, the protected setup always hides it, and the public never sees it without the click. `id` is what the relay stores and accepts (lower case, a to z and underscore; an item's labels are its ids joined by commas), `label` is what the apps show, `desc` is the line under it. The relay reads this file at start (src/relay/media.rs `labels`), so a label added here is accepted after a restart. Adult (NSFW) content is NOT a label: it is held back until it is researched into a dated findings document and the operator decides, so the server's rules do not allow it on the Media page.

labels.label: Spoiler
labels.desc: Shows something people may want to find out for themselves

labels.label: Flashing lights
labels.desc: Rapid flashes or strobing that can affect people with photosensitive epilepsy

labels.label: Graphic
labels.desc: Injury, blood or other content some people would rather not see unwarned
